title: Superpower footer
description: A calm, airy footer. Left: a heavy lowercase wordmark, a newsletter line with a pill email field and a dark pill button, an app box (QR code and a small 'get the app' tag) and a row of small grey icon tiles. Right: three columns of grouped links with grey group titles and a few social links with icons. A hairline, then copyright, legal links and a certification note. On desktop it is a white 12px-radius card (made to float over superpower-closer's photo); on phones it is flat on the faint grey page.
notes: groups with newColumn start a new desktop column; phones show the groups two by two in order
